simulator_adapters.roller_core_reason: Approximate foam compression in the CAD's roughly 145 mm inter-deck gap; official 150 mm fuel remains unchanged.
simulator_adapters.side_guides: Passive convex envelopes of original CAD faces, plus continuous passive mouth guides; no powered traction or animation.
simulator_adapters.retention: Lower-entry and pre-flywheel gates open for feed/reverse and close only after their volume clears.
simulator_adapters.intake_handoff: Existing pickup rises over the kicker, then hands down to the lower roller bed. Four original backing segments stop before the downward handoff.
simulator_adapters.accelerator_interlock: Additional simulator interlock: during a firing-state re-aim, command a zero-speed contact target directly, without waiting for the motor reference to ramp down. The 60000 RPM/s contact ramp and bounded forces still apply; resume feed after accelerator readiness. No braking during reverse recovery or disabled mode.
simulator_adapters.pump_braking: Finite velocity braking toward the nominal source windows; 0.15-rotation upper reversal tolerance (source controller position-goal tolerance) and 2 mm upper approach margin are simulator adapters.
simulator_adapters.pump_priority: An explicit pending or active hard-pump request takes priority over the delayed automatic soft-pump default after recovery.
simulator_adapters.chassis_collision_mode: Discrete at the native 4.5 ms physics step, following the installed-player dense-fuel collision-mode comparison.
simulator_adapters.accelerator_speed_mapping: The 2200 RPM simulator reference maps proportionally to 2.5 m/s, including acceleration and braking; source motor commands remain separate.
simulator_adapters.hopper_kinematics: Main hopper walls, storage floor and net frame fixed to chassis. Only intake/kicker retracts. Legacy hopperRail names the front carrier; no stored-fuel floor traction contact.
simulator_adapters.rejected_net_comparison: 1.05 rest-length scale reduced recorded trench escapes from ten to three, but failed the unchanged 50-ball capacity minimum with 48 collected in the first larger-fill heading. Keep 1.35.
simulator_adapters.lower_mouth_detection: The configured mouth top remains local Y 0.275 m. Admission checks the physical sphere lower surface (centre minus radius) crossing that top, with centre Y at least 0.13 m, centre Z between -0.14 and 0.105 m, and centre X within 0.10 m of the lane centre. Upper-floor fuel must descend before contact; no fuel geometry is changed.

limits: Contact speeds, force budgets, hard-core compliance and lateral damping are simulator calibration, not measured hardware transmission or motor torque. Forces act only inside the mechanism with equal chassis reaction. No in-flight corrections, fuel resizing, parenting or velocity assignments.
native_roller_storage: Nine definitions reconstructed from Transform[] visual references and Vector3[] center/geometry arrays; nested managed Roller[] loaded empty in the native player.
